name: Ring of Replacement
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of telekinesis. When the wearer attempts to use the ring’s powers, however, he and the object he was trying to manipulate swap locations. When this occurs, the ring drops from his finger at the wearer’s point of origin.

Should the wearer find himself in a solid area he takes damage equal to 1d6 per 10 feet moved to the target and is expelled into the closest open area.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of telekinesis

Identification DC 34
False Identification DC 24
